description: Scorpio decan 1 (October 23 to November 1): personality, love, work and growth, with Pluto as sub-ruler of the first ten degrees of Scorpio.
answer: In Western astrology, the first decan of Scorpio covers 0° to 9° of the sign, roughly October 23 to November 1, with Pluto as its sub-ruler, the sign's own planet. It is read as depth, focus and transformation at their most concentrated. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Scorpio decan 1 personality
paragraphs: Scorpio's opening decan doubles down on Pluto, which serves as the sign's modern ruler and also as sub-ruler for these first ten degrees. Astrologers usually treat this as the sign's undiluted core: emotionally intense, intensely private and drawn to whatever lies beneath the surface of a situation. People here are often described as having a stillness that others find magnetic or slightly unnerving. They tend to observe before speaking and to remember everything they observe. Small talk can feel like a waste of energy, while a single honest conversation about something that matters may satisfy them for weeks. One real connection beats a crowd of pleasant ones.

Pluto is associated with power, endings and regeneration, so this decan's life story is frequently told as a series of reinventions. When something stops working, they rarely patch it; they would rather strip it back and rebuild. That capacity for renewal is a genuine strength, though it can come with an all-or-nothing temperament. Trust is extended slowly and withdrawn decisively. Control can become a comfort, especially after a painful experience, and vulnerability may feel like handing someone a weapon. Yet the same intensity makes them unusually loyal, resilient under pressure and willing to face truths that others prefer to leave buried in the cupboard.

sections.heading: Scorpio decan 1 in love and at work
paragraphs: In love, the first decan of Scorpio tends to want everything or nothing. Casual dating rarely holds their interest; they are looking for a bond that can survive honesty about difficult things. Once committed, they are often fiercely devoted and highly attuned to a partner's moods. The intensity cuts both ways, though. Jealousy, testing behaviour or long silences can appear when they feel unsure of their footing. Partners who are consistent and transparent tend to earn their trust most easily. For their part, saying what they need plainly, instead of waiting to see whether it is noticed, eases a great deal of tension.

At work, doubled Pluto favours depth over breadth. Investigation, forensic analysis, psychology, crisis management, auditing, strategy and any role that involves handling confidential material tend to suit them. They can concentrate for long stretches and are rarely satisfied with a surface answer. Colleagues often notice their composure in emergencies. Power dynamics fascinate them, and they may quietly map who really makes decisions in an organisation. The risk is secrecy or reluctance to delegate. Sharing more of their reasoning, and trusting others with part of the load, tends to make their formidable focus far easier to work alongside.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Scorpio decan 1: what Pluto adds
paragraphs: The first decan covers 0° to 9° of Scorpio, which in most years means birthdays from October 23 to November 1. First decans take the sign's own ruler, so Pluto rules both the sign and this decan, which is why it is often called the purest expression of Scorpio. The other two decans of Scorpio belong to Neptune (decan 2) and the Moon (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Pluto lends intensity, depth and a drive to transform. A Pluto decan is commonly read as more private and probing, unafraid of difficult truths, slow to trust and capable of remarkable reinvention after a setback. Plutonian decans are often linked with research, crisis work, psychology and finance, and their usual lesson is to share power and let others in. Here Pluto doubles up with the sign's own ruler, so Scorpio's intensity, loyalty, perception and emotional depth come through with little filtering.

sections.heading: Growth for Scorpio decan 1
paragraphs: Growth for this decan often begins with recognising that control and safety are not the same thing. Small experiments in openness, such as sharing a worry before it has been fully resolved, can show that vulnerability need not end in betrayal. It can also help to let go of things gradually rather than through dramatic clean breaks, so change feels less like an earthquake. Physical outlets, from long walks to strenuous exercise, are often recommended for discharging intensity. The aim is not to soften who they are. It is to let their depth become a resource for connection rather than a fortress.

Within Scorpio, decan 2 leans towards intensity softened into intuition, imagination and quiet compassion and decan 3 leans towards protective loyalty and emotional memory wrapped around a steel core. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Is the first decan of Scorpio the most intense?
faq.answer: It is traditionally described that way. Pluto serves as both the sign's modern ruler and this decan's sub-ruler, so themes of depth, privacy, loyalty and transformation are emphasised. The rest of the birth chart, especially the Moon and rising sign, can moderate or amplify that intensity.

faq.question: What are the dates of Scorpio decan 1?
faq.answer: In most years October 23 to November 1, the days when the Sun is between 0° and 9° of Scorpio. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Scorpio decan 1?
faq.answer: Pluto. In the triplicity system each water sign's decans take the rulers of the water signs in order, starting with Scorpio's own ruler, Pluto.
